plan.title: Single-stage RFQ cannot delete the only row

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provide the required event title so the create flow is valid.
Apply an RFQ template so the product sheet is available.
Create exactly one product row, establishing the last-row deletion condition.
Attempt to remove the sole row and require the product to refuse the operation.

args.text: At least one product is required, so the last one can't be removed.
